text:
The median asking rent in Bocholt stands at 10.0 €/m², up 2.8 % year‑on‑year and 23.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. A tight market balance and a vacancy rate of 1.5 % keep momentum positive, while the typical 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month.

Affordability remains moderate: rent‑burden for two residents is 12.3 %, and the asking premium over existing rents is 60 %. Listings stay on the market for roughly 30 days, with only 20 % let within a week.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.38 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.05 €/m² and 10.78 €/m², implying a 3.8 % increase.
